description: ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: flood hazard datasets (zone alea) is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 81 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: zone d'aléa fort de submersion par débordement à l'horizon 2100; Zone d'aléa du PPRi Moselle Amont révisé pour la commune de Bussang; Zone d'aléa du PPRI dans le bassin versant du PORTO; Zone d'aléa du PPRi du val d’allier issoirien(63DDT20110004) approuvé . Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
